title: Gaugeboard launch readiness: beta orchestration, release notes alignment, and customer feedback playbook
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Purpose: Prepare a coordinated launch for Gaugeboard (beta) focused on a small set of lighthouse customers. Deliver a repeatable playbook that aligns product, engineering, design, support, and GTM on release notes, observability, and feedback capture. This ticket codifies go/no-go criteria, communication templates, and the day-0 to day-30 customer success cadence.
objectives: Define beta eligibility and lighthouse account selection criteria
Align release notes and API/SDK change log with engineering and docs
Create a customer feedback intake and triage workflow tied to telemetry
Operationalize success criteria and rollback/runbook for P0 regressions
Prepare GTM collateral and onboarding checklist for pilot customers
deliverables: Lighthouse customer onboarding checklist (ops + security pre-checks)
Release notes draft + inline code/endpoint examples for SDKs
Feedback intake form + triage matrix and Slack routing playbook
Telemetry dashboard template with key signals (latency, error rate, token cost)
30-day success criteria and retention measurement plan
rollout_steps: Week -3: Finalize lighthouse customer list and sign NDAs where required
Week -2: Freeze API surface and draft release notes; docs review by Eng/Design
Week -1: Run internal canary with 3 internal apps; confirm telemetry dashboards
Day 0: Onboard first 5 lighthouse customers with dedicated kickoff calls
Day 1-7: Daily health checks, weekly feedback synthesis, and immediate P0 hotfix path
Day 8-30: Bi-weekly check-ins, collect NPS + qualitative feedback, evaluate retention
release_notes_coordination: Owner: Docs (assigned to Elena Park) to maintain canonical changelog
Engineering to provide API diff and migration notes by 2026-03-08
Design to supply UI screenshots and usage guidance by 2026-03-10
PM to approve final release notes and signoff by 2026-03-12
Channel plan: in-console banner + email to lighthouse accounts on Day 0
feedback_and_telemetry: Primary signals: 95th percentile latency, 99th percentile error, per-token cost delta
Supplemental signals: successful calls per customer, average session length, usage spikes
Feedback channels: in-console feedback button, dedicated Slack channel (#gaugeboard-beta), structured intake form
Triage rules: P0 = data loss or >10% increase in 95p latency; route to on-call eng immediately
Synthesis cadence: every 72 hours first week, then weekly summaries stored in Drive
success_criteria: Technical: 95th percentile latency within SLA (<=250ms) and error rate <0.5% for lighthouse accounts
Adoption: at least 3 lighthouse accounts with weekly active usage by day 30
Quality: no unresolved P0 incidents after day 7; documented regression threshold for rollback
Business: positive qualitative feedback from primary contacts and >70% of surveyed customers indicating 'valuable'
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Unclear API changes cause customer integration failures -> Mitigation: publish a migration guide and provide a compatibility shim for 2 weeks
Risk: Telemetry gaps hide regressions -> Mitigation: mandatory telemetry hooks instrumented before onboarding, run smoke tests
Risk: Support load spikes overwhelm CS -> Mitigation: create triage templates, assign temporary rotations, and enable priority routing in Support
Risk: Security review delays onboarding -> Mitigation: pre-clear lighthouse accounts with Security and provide checklist for on-prem customers
acceptance_criteria: Onboarding checklist signed off by Security and CS for first 5 lighthouse customers
Release notes published in the docs site and linked in Console prior to Day 0
Telemetry dashboards live and smoke-tested with synthetic traffic
Feedback intake flow validated and triage rota staffed for first 30 days
PM sign-off that initial 30-day success measurement plan is instrumented
